messages:
tess: Heads up - Northbrook POC can't finish dedicated reservation. Asking for help.
liam: Which params did they request?
tess: reserved_gpus=8 region=us-east1 az_affinity=us-east1-b strict=true
provision-bot: RESERVATION_ERROR code=409 msg="ZONE_CAPACITY_UNAVAILABLE"
sophie: Could you paste the provisioner output?
tess: ```
2026-03-21T08:10:01Z provisioner: init_reservation id=Z-9981 params={gpus:8,region:us-east1,az:us-east1-b,affinity:strict}
2026-03-21T08:10:03Z cloud: Allocate failed status=409 {"error":"capacityUnavailable","detail":"Requested GPU sku not currently available in zone"}
2026-03-21T08:10:03Z provisioner: RESERVATION_ERROR id=Z-9981 code=ZONE_CAPACITY_UNAVAILABLE
```
david-infra: Looks like provider-side capacity, not our scheduler. Do they have quota in other AZs?
tess: They say quota exists in us-east1-a and c but they require b for compliance reasons.
liam: For sales deck we need quick numbers: what's delta if we promise single-AZ guaranteed vs multi-AZ flexible for 12-month reserved?
sophie: Ballpark: single-AZ guaranteed customers pay ~15% premium because we limit overcommit and can't bin-pack across AZs. Also bump minimum commitment because of reduced utilization. I'll pull exact price list but tell them ~15% + $X/mo per GPU.
david-infra: Short-term mitigation: create two 4-GPU reservations in a/c and set network-routing so model data is pinned to a close subnet. Not identical but may satisfy latency.
tess: Customer insisted on AZ b for data locality. Can we do a network-level hop to route through b?
david-infra: Not without running instances in b. Could offer a control-plane proxy in b (bare-metal partner) but that's a different product and needs legal signoff.
liam: Also they triggered 429s when stomping the provision API yesterday: 429 exceed_provision_rate. We should recommend backoff and a per-minute cap.
sophie: I'll attach a recommended client-retry snippet and suggest concurrency <=1 for the POC.
tess: They've also filed a security questionnaire asking where keys are stored. Answer we provided: Dedicated uses customer KMS when in Private; for Dedicated hosted we offer optional customer-managed keys via KMS integration. Link: https://redwood.example.com/security/dedicated-kms
liam: Create a short runbook: 1) offer split pools as temp 2) request quota bump with provider (24-72h) 3) price delta for guaranteed-AZ (estimate) 4) update POC script for backoff.
sophie: I'll update the sheet and send to finance for the exact premium number.
david-infra: Requesting quota bump now (ticket CP-5567). If provider approves we can re-run single-AZ reservation.
tess: I'll tell Northbrook we can try split pools as interim and that final pricing for guaranteed-AZ will follow. Schedule meeting to review options at 10:00 ET.
liam: :thumbsup:
